h3:1. Surprise Courier Fees at the Finish Line
h2:From Menu Exploration to Scalloped Ticket Receipt
text: ← RETURN TO SELECTED WORK CASE STUDY 04 SPECIALTY COMMERCE DRINK CUSTOMIZER 6 PAYMENT OPTIONS Aura Coffee & Kitchen — A Warm, One-Page Coffee Ordering Experience A warm, welcoming coffee-shop store inspired by the mobile apps people already love. Customize your drink (size, dairy or plant milk, sweetness, ice), watch your free-delivery progress in the Shopping Bag, and check out on one page with 6 payment options (GCash, Maya, GrabPay, card, QR Ph and cash on delivery). Every order ends with a scalloped paper-style ticket. ☕ Launch Live Aura Coffee Store ↗ View Figma Community File ↗ Launch Interactive Prototype ↗ PLATFORM Responsive Web App (Mobile & Desktop) DISCIPLINE Specialty Food & Beverage UI/UX · Checkout Design ROLE Lead Product Designer & Frontend Engineer (Solo) STACK Vanilla HTML, CSS & JS · Shopping Bag Saved in the Browser (localStorage) ● THE ENGINEERING CHALLENGE Standard e-commerce templates (Shopify/WooCommerce) suffer from heavy third-party script bloat, slow mobile load times, generic checkout flows, and rigid carts that don't support custom beverage modifiers. ● THE ARCHITECTURE SOLUTION Built a dependency-free storefront in vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript: a drink customizer, a Shopping Bag that stays saved in your browser, and 6 payment options (GCash, Maya, GrabPay, card, QR Ph and cash on delivery). 0 Frameworks 100% VANILLA HTML5, CSS & ES6+ 1-Page Checkout BAG, DELIVERY & PAYMENT ON ONE SCREEN 6 Options PAYMENT OPTIONS: GCASH, MAYA, GRABPAY, CARD, QR PH & COD 100% Client-Side BAG & ORDERS SAVED IN YOUR BROWSER How an order flows — from the menu to a warm order ticket, all playable in the live demo: Step 1 Menu Pick a Drink Browse hot classics, iced brews, frappés and fresh bakes, or search by name. Step 2 Customizer Make It Yours Choose size, milk (whole, oat, almond or soy), sweetness and ice. The price updates as you go. Step 3 Shopping Bag Fill Your Bag The bag drawer slides in with a meter showing how much more you need for free delivery (₱500). Step 4 Checkout One Page, Not Four Contact details, delivery address and delivery option all sit on a single page. Step 5 Payment Pay Your Way 6 payment options: GCash, Maya, GrabPay, card, QR Ph or cash on delivery. The demo charges nothing. Step 6 Order Ticket Watch It Brew A scalloped paper-style ticket recaps your order and follows it from received to on its way. TABLE OF CONTENTS 01. Overview & Vision 02. Usability Audits & Friction Points 03. End-to-End Coffee Flow 04. Local Payments & Reassurance 05. Business Impact & Takeaways // 01 · OVERVIEW & VISION Balancing Craft Warmth & Checkout Velocity Specialty coffee ordering is deeply personal: customers expect nuanced control over cup size, dairy vs. plant-based milk (oat, almond, soy), sweetness levels, and ice dilution. However, in conventional e-commerce platforms, complex variant drop-downs and multi-page checkouts trigger steep cart abandonment. “How might we design a coffee ordering experience that feels as inviting, appetizing, and tactile as walking into your favorite neighborhood roastery?” Aura Coffee & Kitchen solves this by pairing a warm oat-milk aesthetic (soft cream, amber caramel, pill buttons) with a fast, simple ordering flow: a drink customizer, a slide-over bag drawer that tracks free delivery, and a one-page checkout built around the ways Filipinos actually pay. // 02 · USABILITY AUDITS & FRICTION POINTS Eliminating Drop-Off in Drink Ordering A systematic audit of standard food & beverage ordering funnels revealed three primary friction points: 1. Surprise Courier Fees at the Finish Line Hiding delivery costs until the final payment page triggers immediate price shock. Aura introduces an active free delivery meter in the bag drawer, encouraging upsells to reach the ₱500 threshold. 2. Clunky, Inflexible Customization Requiring customers to navigate away from the menu just to pick oat milk or adjust sweetness causes cognitive fatigue. Aura utilizes a focused, single-viewport modal with immediate visual feedback. 3. Multi-Step Checkout Exhaustion Forcing 4 separate page transitions for Customer Info, Address, Shipping, and Payment creates friction on mobile. Aura consolidates everything onto a single, clear 1-page layout with one-click GCash and Maya buttons. // 03 · END-TO-END COFFEE FLOW From Menu Exploration to Scalloped Ticket Receipt Explore the wireframe-to-production design artifacts below: Fig 1.1 — Slide-over Bag Drawer Wireframe Fig 1.2 — Production Bag Drawer with Delivery Meter Fig 2.1 — 1-Page Consolidated Checkout Structure Fig 2.2 — Single-View Checkout with Philippine Wallets Fig 3.1 — 1-Tap Express GCash / Maya Flow Fig 3.2 — Payment Form Design (the live demo processes no payment) Fig 4.1 — Order Confirmation Wireframe Fig 4.2 — Scalloped Ticket Receipt with Live Brewing Tracker // 04 · LOCAL PAYMENTS & REASSURANCE Local Relevance & Visual Reassurance With 6 payment options (GCash, Maya, GrabPay, card, QR Ph and cash on delivery), local coffee lovers can pay the way they already do. Real-time form validation, explicit order recap cards with itemized modifications, and an instant order confirmation ticket create complete transparency and peace of mind. // 05 · OUTCOMES & KEY TAKEAWAYS What Shipped 0 Frameworks: Vanilla HTML, CSS & ES6+, So the Page Ships Only the Store 1 Page Checkout: Bag, Delivery & Payment on One Screen Live Playable Demo at /aura-store, Checkout & Order Ticket Included ☕ Launch Live Aura Coffee Store & 1-Page Checkout ↗ ← PREVIOUS CASE STUDY 03 · Memory Core (Lessons-Learned Memory) NEXT CASE STUDY → 05 · Lumina Analytics (Study & Focus Dashboard)
